Hi team, given the current state of the devnet, can we
1. change the meeting to a weekly cadence instead of bi-weekly? don't need to take the entire duration if there aren't that many topics to discuss, but a more frequent touch point could be very beneficial
2. can we change the meeting to a little more U.S. friendly time? 

🙏
